Bound Elemental Ring of Frost

Minimum level 29
Item Type Jewelry / Ring
Slot Finger
Race Absolutely Required None
Binding Bound to Character on Acquire
Durability 390
Material SteelSteel: Steel is the common metal used to make weapons and armor.
Hardness 49
Base Value 001160100011,601ppPlatinum Piece 
Weight 0.10 lbs
Location Legendary Lord of Blades, end and optional chest
Enchantments
  • Ice Lore +22%Ice Lore +22: Passive: Your Cold spells gain a 22% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
  • Glaciation +148Glaciation +148: Passive: +148 Equipment bonus to Cold Spell Power.
  • Alchemical Water AttunementAlchemical Water Attunement: Attacks and offensive spells have a chance to inflict ten stacks of cold damage over time, fading one stack at a time. This effect has an internal cooldown.
  • Legendary Elemental EnergyLegendary Elemental Energy: Harnessing a small amount of power and potential of the raw elements, this item gives you a +150 bonus to your maximum spell points. This stacks with all bonuses except for Legendary Elemental Energy.
  • Green Augment SlotBlue, Green, Yellow, and Colorless
  • Blue Augment SlotBlue and Colorless
  • Chained ElementalsChained Elementals: While wearing two pieces from the Chained Elemental set, you gain:
    • +6% Artifact bonus to Fire, Cold, Acid, and Electric Spell Critical Chance
    • +30 Artifact bonus to Fire, Cold, Acid, and Electric Spell Power
  • Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.
    (This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
Upgradeable?
Description This elemental ring is sourced from the Cannith Engines that power the Manufactury.
